prompt: Candid full-length documentary photograph in a narrow neighborhood alley on a cloudy morning. Catch a middle-aged woman as she steps up one stair with a heavy grocery bag hanging from one hand. From an oblique side view just far enough away to include her head, both shoes and the distinct stair treads below them: her leading shoe takes weight flat on the next tread, bent knee over it, her body traveling forward and up; her departing heel rises off the tread below. Her fingers gather the taut bag handles, the groceries settle into the sagging base, the loaded arm hangs long and the free arm balances naturally. Keep the bag clear of both shoes. Ordinary worn surfaces and broad overcast daylight, the quiet immediacy of an unstaged photograph.

A natural, close everyday photograph in a teahouse beside a window. A deep brown-skinned adult is handing a single handled ceramic teacup to another adult. Frame both faces and the meeting hands together in a relaxed waist-up two-shot. Catch the shared instant of support: the giver still has fingers curled through the handle with thumb resting at its top, the other adult reaches from the opposite side with palm up and fingertips meeting the underside of the cup. The rim is level. Show the handle opening and the contact along the base, with each wrist leading clearly back to its own sleeve. They attend to the exchange. Broad soft window light wraps both faces and the hands; let the giver's deep complexion retain luminous midtones, a softer lighter palm and shadow detail.

Chest-up documentary photographic portrait in an evening sewing room. A white-haired elderly man listens to a person standing beside him; a softly rendered standing shoulder at the edge locates the speaker. Frame his face, neck and upper chest in three-quarter view, the eyes aimed together slightly up toward the speaker, his head turning gently from the shoulders. His expression is a small listening smile, gentle lift in the cheeks and a quiet asymmetry at the mouth. Cool blue dusk from a nearby window brushes his temple, cheek and the side of his neck. A warm sewing task lamp lights the other cheek and falls away across his jaw onto the neck and open collar. Let the two sources mingle softly in the turning planes. Unretouched skin with the varied texture of age and fine lines following the expression, receding in soft shadow; everyday fabric and the sewing workspace visible behind.

Observational watercolor on textured paper, a full-length figure study of a young adult sitting on an outdoor bench, bending forward and tying one sneaker with both hands in soft open shade. View slightly obliquely from the side; allow space around head, both shoes and bench. Weight rests through the seat, elbows naturally reach past the bent knee toward the near shoe on the ground; the far foot stays relaxed and distinct. One hand pinches a small lace loop at the tongue while the other draws the other lace around it. Leave a readable silhouette for each wrist and show the short lace segments into both grasps. A connected family of transparent skin washes flows around the face, forearms and hands, with gentle value shifts under the jaw and fingers. Restrained observed watercolor edges and paper light, the clearest marks at the knot.
